items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: I mentioned the fact that Budd Johnson was with the band. Budd Johnson did some arranging also.

ctx.x: "Air Mail Special." Which was a Charlie Christian tune. We had a very fine arrangement on that. And while he was with us, one of his pieces that later became a standard was a thing called "Good Bait." And any number of other things that Tadd wrote for the band. In listening to his arrangements and everything, they also made a profound impression on my musicianship as a writer and as a pianist.
